headline: Weathered and Stlican Fronts Ease as Passage Stirs
war_summary: The latest ledger shows a slight easing on the two busiest divided fronts, though the guns have by no means fallen silent. Weathered Expanse records 60 strategic-base events in 24 hours, up from 58, but only three in the latest two hours and 17 in six; its holdings remain split five Warden, four Colonial. Stlican Shelf has slipped to 53 daily events from 54, with four in two hours and 20 in six, while its map stands at five Warden, two Colonial, and two neutral bases. Callahan’s Passage has grown to 20 daily events from 18, including four in the latest two hours, and remains entirely Warden-held despite exceptionally heavy casualties on both sides. Godcrofts has quieted sharply to 17 events from 23, with two in six hours and none in two. Linn Mercy retains 12 daily events and a divided three-Warden, eight-Colonial ledger, but no fresh base movement in the latest day’s immediate hours. Deadlands likewise remains at 16 events, all eleven bases Colonial-held, with no recent activity since the earlier report.
